sponsors.description: Qatar Airways, the Best Airline in the Middle East, operates one of the youngest fleets in the world, offering exceptional service and connectivity to over 170 destinations worldwide. With its state-of-the-art aircraft and award-winning hospitality, Qatar Airways is committed to delivering a world-class travel experience to its passengers. The airline is renowned for its innovation, reliability, and commitment to safety, ensuring passengers enjoy a seamless journey from start to finish. Qatar Airways strives to set industry benchmarks in customer service, and continues to maintain its position as one of the most respected and trusted airlines globally, having won World’s Best Airline for an unprecedented seven times, and World’s Best Business Class for 10 consecutive years. Qatar Airways continues to elevate the standards of air travel and connect people across the globe and is committed to supporting sports through its large portfolio in its mission to bring people together.

In collaboration with us, Wilson has once again pushed the boundaries of innovation with the introduction of two new additions to the global courts: the Wilson Premier Padel Balls.
 
Rigorously tested by the world’s top players and custom-designed for them to excel at the highest levels of competition.
 
These balls have been meticulously designed to elevate the game of padel, providing unmatched consistency, durability, and playability in varied playing conditions. The Wilson Premier Padel Ball is perfect for slowing down the game on faster court surfaces. This ball has been optimized for high altitude and hot, humid conditions. The Wilson Premier Padel Speed Ball is built for slower court surfaces and colder conditions, making it livelier and more responsive.

Mondo, official supplier of artificial turf for Premier Padel, is a leading brand in the artificial turf sales market for padel courts, with more than 20.000 courts supplied worldwide. Currently, its texturized artificial turf systems, SupercourtTM, have been used in more than 135 padel professional tournaments all around the world. Mondo's R&D laboratories have once again succeeded: the company has completed the development of Premier Supercourt X3, the new artificial turf developed specifically for Premier Padel, unique in the market. The new system marks a before and after in padel surfaces, both in its sporting performance - allowing players to have total control over the game - and in their morphology, as it combines three textured filaments with different morphologies, two of which are completely new. Premier Supercourt X3 offers more control in the game, consistent ball bounce across the court, and an extraordinary aesthetic appearance.

The WHO Foundation is an independent grant-making foundation working alongside the World Health Organization (WHO) to address global health challenges. By mobilizing resources and fostering partnerships, the WHO Foundation strives to support WHO in achieving its critical health objectives.

institutional_partners_sponsors.description: The International Padel Players Association represents and works for padel women players worldwide. IPPA’s aim is to contribute to the development of the padel game while helping women players to fulfil their potential and develop valuable careers as sport professionals.
